# AGENTS

Primary workspace instructions live in [copilot-instructions.md](copilot-instructions.md).

This file is an alias entrypoint so tooling that looks for `AGENTS.md` discovers the same guidance.

## Key rule (must follow)

Whenever behavior, API, parsing support, painters/schemes, compatibility, or build workflow changes, update `README.md` in the same change set.

## Source of truth

- Keep detailed, canonical rules in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Keep this file short and aligned with that source.
